text:
carla_partnerships: Heads up  Marketplace private-offer for OrionCloud co-sell. Primary asks: flexible commit (12 or 24mo), hardware kicker options, SI enablement credits, and renewal defaults. Need quick inputs.

henry_sales: Customer prefers 12mo with option to extend. Suggest 3 tiers: 150k / 750k / 3M. Discounts 8% / 16% / 28%. HW kicker only for 3M: 7% credit.

simon_pm: Keep SKUs simple. mapping ideas:
```
orion_commit_150k
orion_commit_750k
orion_commit_3m
orion_hw_credit
```
Recommend standard 45-day onboarding SLA and co-sell playbook.

nora_finance: Margin floor 60%. HW kicker cap at $200k. For 12mo allow monthly billing with 3mo deposit; for 24mo allow quarterly billing with 1mo deposit. Renewal: auto-notify 90 days ahead with pricing review window.

alexa_ops: Launch rhythm: private listing + partner webinar (T+2), then field enablement and public blog at T+30. Marketplace metadata needs legal-approved case study language.

marketplace-bot: draft private-offer created at /marketplace/privates/orioncloud-co-sell (creator: carla_partnerships)

carla_partnerships: Two questions: do we permit cross-cloud credits (e.g., converting unused commit to dedicated credits across regions)? and who signs the press?

henry_sales: Cross-cloud convert is ok but limit conversions to 25% of unused commit. I'll liaise with marketing on press.

simon_pm: Add fallback policy: if capacity constrained in region, route to hosted variant with an uplift charge and auto credit reconciliation. Engineering to confirm region capacity.

nora_finance: I'll do margin sims. Also propose 20% non-refundable deposit for 3M tier.

carla_partnerships: scheduling 20-min sync tomorrow 11am PT. link: https://redwood.internal/cal/astra-orion-sync. Bring term-sheet drafts.
